opportunities.title: Dog Walking at Animal Shelter
opportunities.description: Help rescue dogs get exercise and socialization. Flexible hours, all skill levels welcome.

opportunities.title: Trail Cleanup at Riverside Park
opportunities.description: Join us for a 4-hour trail cleanup on Saturday mornings. All tools and supplies provided.

opportunities.title: Tech Tutor for Seniors
opportunities.description: Teach seniors how to use email, video calls, and social media. Virtual, 1-2 hours per week.

opportunities.title: Library Reading Buddy Program
opportunities.description: Read with elementary kids once a week. Help build confidence and love of reading.

opportunities.title: Food Bank Sorting
opportunities.description: Sort and pack donations for families in need. 3-hour shifts available, groups welcome!

opportunities.title: Senior Companion Program
opportunities.description: Visit with seniors, play games, help with activities. Makes a huge difference in their lives.

opportunities.title: Beach Cleanup & Ocean Advocacy
opportunities.description: Collect trash and learn about marine conservation. Virtual workshop + in-person cleanup.

opportunities.title: Youth After-School Mentor
opportunities.description: Mentor a young person weekly. Help them with homework, build confidence, be a friend.
